Ready or Not is an intense and immersive tactical shooter game that delivers an unparalleled level of realism and excitement. The game's attention to detail, engaging gameplay, and stunning graphics make it a must-play for fans of the genre. I highly recommend this game to anyone who is looking for a challenging and immersive tactical shooter experience.

One of the things that sets Ready or Not apart from other tactical shooter games is its commitment to realism. From the accurate police procedures to the realistic weapons and gear, every aspect of the game has been designed to make you feel like you're really part of the elite SWAT team. The game's challenging AI enemies also require you to think strategically and use your skills and tactics to overcome them, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement to the gameplay. Overall, Ready or Not is an outstanding game that delivers an immersive and thrilling tactical shooter experience that is hard to beat.

In January 2016, Mesa police responded to a report of a man pointing a rifle out of a hotel window. It was in fact Daniel Shaver showing a pellet gun that he used at his exterminator job to a couple other hotel guests in his room.

Police ordered Shaver out of the hotel room and onto the ground, with his hands behind his head. But instead of handcuffing Shaver, officers—bizarrely—started barking confusing and contradictory orders at him to crawl toward them. As a clearly terrified and drunk Shaver tried to crawl toward the police, he appeared to reach toward his waistband to pull up his sagging shorts. A Mesa officer, Philip Mitchell Brailsford, shot Shaver five times with an AR-15, killing him.
Let PC choose between the censored and uncensored versions. We should not be forced to adhere to console regulations.

-this is a P2P game yet there is no server browser, only vague matchmaking (there was literally a mod for ages that added a server browser like come on!)
-you have the ability to choose either AP or JHP ammo for penetration or damadge respectively, but no option to choose general purpose ammo (I.E FMJ)
-the non-lethal options are ridiculously inconsistent, with suspects sometimes completley ignoring things that are supposed to at the very least daze them to continue mag dumping on you

I could going into detail about AI and performance but this will be waaay to long, I do really hope they continue working on it, but from my point of view, it looks like they slapped a "1.0" sticker so they arent required to keep working on this
